features.name: Giant's Power
features.desc: While raging, you grow (like Enlarge/Reduce): increased reach, extra damage, and a crushing throw of objects or creatures.

features.name: Elemental Cleaver
features.desc: When you enter a Rage, you imbue your melee weapon with an element of your choice: it deals an extra 1d6 damage of that type (Acid, Cold, Fire, or Thunder) and gains the Thrown property with a range of 20/60 feet, returning to you after being thrown. You can change the type each time you enter a Rage.

features.name: Mighty Impel
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you telekinetically push creatures around you.

features.name: Demiurgic Colossus
features.desc: You become even larger; Advantage on Strength saving throws and increased extra damage.
